limitations: Project design and intended benefits; implementation and outcomes are not established.

title: Climate micro-mobilities as adaptation practice in the Pacific: the case of Samoa
organization: Anita Latai-Niusulu, Masami Tsujita and Andreas Neef; Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B
temporal_coverage: Talanoa fieldwork June–August 2021; mobility histories cover participants' prior 10–30 years; site context includes 2016 census data and 2009 tsunami experience.
methodology: Qualitative comparison using Samoan-language talanoa interviews; 40 households invited across two sites.
limitations: Small non-random sample; mixed movement drivers; not prevalence or causal-violence research.

title: The effects of Climate Change on the small village of Salei'a
temporal_coverage: Climate risks and Adaptation Fund-supported works reported as of October 2019; programme began in 2013.
methodology: UNDP project case story drawing on project information and a statement by Salei'a's mayor.
limitations: Sponsored project account, not an independent impact evaluation; reported completion and benefits are bounded to the article's 2019 account.

title: Community-Based Adaptation in Small Island Developing States, and Mekong-Asia-Pacific Regions
organization: United Nations Development Programme, Global Environment Facility Small Grants Programme
temporal_coverage: Regional programme case account, including Matafa'a outcomes reported during and after the 2011 El Niño drought.
methodology: UNDP-GEF SGP regional report summarizing Matafa'a adaptation-project implementation.
limitations: Programme-reported, not independently evaluated; historical, not current water status.

title: Pacific Peoples and Climate-Related (Im)Mobility: A Synthesis Report on Scale, Pattern and Impact, Now and in the Future
organization: Bruce Burson, Evelyn Marsters, Richard Bedford and Sandy Morrison; prepared for New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
temporal_coverage: Synthesis published June 2024, drawing on earlier and commissioned Pacific household, community and mobility research; Samoa examples include 2009 tsunami relocation and 2023–2024 fieldwork synthesis.
methodology: Synthesis of published/commissioned Pacific studies, case reports, fieldwork and policy sources.
limitations: Regional, not Samoa prevalence research; violence signal is caveated.

title: Pacific Region Preparedness, Adaptation, and Resilience Program – Samoa Project: Environmental and Social Management Framework
organization: Government of Samoa, Pacific Region Preparedness, Adaptation and Resilience Program – Samoa Project
temporal_coverage: Framework dated June 2025 for a six-year project planned to begin in August 2025; township-plan works and risks were preliminary at report date.
methodology: Project framework identifying preliminary risks, safeguards and responsibilities.
limitations: Preparation-stage risks and plans, not outcomes.
